turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
e it properly the very first time?

04:18 PM

For the first use, slide your arm into the arm pocket so your shoulder sits in the cradle cutout, then secure the strap for a snug fit. Your head and neck rest on the pillow while your arm hangs naturally, and it works for both side sleeping and back sleeping.

It can feel different at first, and most people need 1 to 2 weeks to adjust. If you want a visual walkthrough, use this how-to video: https://youtu.be/3WIi-Mk9CMo?si=D1vYJbGWhaHfxsxg
